title: Demonte Colony 3 Locks Pongal 2027 Release After Court-Linked Delay
excerpt: Arulnithi and Priya Bhavani Shankar return in the third Tamil instalment of R. Ajay Gnanamuthu's horror franchise, moved from September 2026 after a Madras High Court injunction in a production rights dispute.
body:
• Demonte Colony 3, the Tamil supernatural horror thriller written and directed by R. Ajay Gnanamuthu, will release during Pongal 2027, Passion Studios announced on its official social media handles.
  • Arulnithi and Priya Bhavani Shankar reprise their roles from the previous instalments; Archana Ravichandran and Meenakshi Govindarajan are also in the cast, with music by Sam CS.
  • The film was initially scheduled for September 2026 and was postponed after the Madras High Court issued an interim injunction in a production rights dispute involving White Knights Entertainment, according to Cinema Express.
  • Language: Tamil. No US theatrical date has been announced — diaspora viewers should expect that detail closer to the Pongal window.

The third trip to Demonte Colony finally has a date. Passion Studios has confirmed that Demonte Colony 3: The End is Too Far will arrive in theatres during Pongal 2027, ending speculation about a film that has been delayed more than once. The announcement post carried the line, "Darkness Will Rule.. PONGAL 2027," Cinema Express reported.

The film and the franchise

The film is a Tamil-language supernatural horror thriller, the third instalment in the Demonte Colony franchise. R. Ajay Gnanamuthu has written and directed it, with a screenplay written with Venkatesh VSA and Arun Haiku Sakthi and dialogues by Pattukkottai Prabakar. Arulnithi and Priya Bhavani Shankar return in the lead roles they played in the previous instalments, joined by Archana Ravichandran and Meenakshi Govindarajan. Sam CS is the music director.

Why it moved

The third chapter was initially scheduled to release in September 2026. It was postponed following legal complications: the Madras High Court issued an interim injunction following a production rights dispute involving White Knights Entertainment, Cinema Express reported. The Pongal 2027 announcement is the makers' first confirmed window since that delay.

Production and what comes next

The film is produced by Sudhan Sundaram under the Passion Studios banner, Manish Singhal under Dangal media, Durgaram Choudhary under RDC media and the director's own Gnanamuthu Pattarai banner, 123Telugu reported. Promotional material released so far has offered glimpses of a darker supernatural narrative, and promotions are expected to kick off soon. For US viewers, the practical detail is still missing: no American theatrical date or distributor has been announced alongside the Pongal window, so Tamil film fans in North America will need to watch for a separate US announcement nearer January 2027.
